when_used: A chargor charges its interest in a title to a chargee by way of informal charge, depositing the documents of title with the chargee as security for all monies covenanted to be paid. The chargee is passed as the transferor and the chargor as the transferee, because the official execution prints the chargee first: it is passed as a company party with its attorneys, seals under its common seal and then signs by those attorneys, while the chargor and the borrower sign as natural persons.

detail_rows.label: The Chargor: Give full name(s) and if corporate the registration number, if any
The Chargee: Give full name(s) and company’s registration number, if any
Borrower Include where lending is to secure a third party. Give full name(s) and if corporate the registration number, if any
Supplemental / Collateral to debenture Insert details of: the principal instrument(s); amount secured; duty paid and; stamp duty receipt number.

body_text.text: The Chargor as legal and or beneficial owner HEREBY CHARGES to the Chargee by way of Informal Charge the interest of the Chargor in the above Title as [a continuing security/term loan security] for the payment and discharge in full of all monies, obligations and liabilities covenanted to be paid or discharged or otherwise secured by this Charge.

The Chargor hereby authorises the Chargee and its agents to register the security created by this Charge in accordance with the provisions of the Land Act, 2012 and the Land Registration Act, 2012 to the satisfaction of the Chargee.
Acknowledgement of Effect of Section 90 of the Land Act, 2012

Pursuant to the provisions of section 56 of the Land Registration Act, 2012 and Section 79(6) of the Land Act, 2012, I/we, the Chargor hereby acknowledge that I/we understand the effect of Section 90 of the Land Act, 2012 and the chargee’s remedies under this Charge. This acknowledgement is signed on behalf of the Chargor by the persons witnessing the affixing of the Common Seal of the Chargor to this Charge.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF this Charge has been duly executed.

extra_blocks.signed_label: SIGNED as a deed by the

foot_notes: All parties including the Borrower(s) must execute.
* Provide full name(s) and registered number Delete whichever is not applicable.
**The person attesting the signature must authenticate the coloured passport size photograph, National ID Number and Tax PIN Number.

custom_fields.name: principal_amount
custom_fields.label: Principal amount
custom_fields.prompt: The principal amount secured by the informal charge, in figures and words

custom_fields.name: borrower_name
custom_fields.label: The Borrower
custom_fields.prompt: Full name of the borrower and, if corporate, the registration number, where the lending secures a third party. Where the chargor is the borrower, give the chargor's own name, because the form carries a signing block for the borrower

custom_fields.name: supplemental_collateral
custom_fields.label: Supplemental or collateral to a debenture
custom_fields.prompt: Details of the principal instrument or instruments, the amount secured, the duty paid and the stamp duty receipt number, where this charge is supplemental or collateral to a debenture

custom_fields.name: documents_deposited
custom_fields.label: Documents deposited with the Chargee
custom_fields.prompt: The documents of title deposited with the chargee, for example the certificate of title

custom_fields.name: additional_provisions
custom_fields.label: Additional provisions
custom_fields.prompt: The additional provisions the law and the contract between the parties require, one paragraph per line
